title: Card pattern authoring page
goal: Open the Card pattern from the library into a Framework-backed authoring page with synchronized quick settings, direct CSS, Preview, persistence, and responsive evidence.

nodes.title: Build Card pattern authoring
nodes.goal: Add the Card route, shared Settings and Preview composition, one declaration-list state model, and scaled library preview.
deliverables: Card Settings bar and Preview route
Synchronized Framework-token controls and direct CSS
acceptanceChecks: Quick controls and direct CSS compile through one state
Invalid CSS preserves the last valid Preview
Oversized library Preview is scaled without changing the actual Card
Desktop and mobile have no horizontal overflow

nodes.title: Verify Card authoring
nodes.goal: Verify route behavior, persistence, accessibility, responsive geometry, tests, check, build, and final diff.
acceptanceChecks: Real-browser desktop and mobile checks pass
No unresolved blocking diff finding remains
